scores.method: monthly grid from 2000; indicator z signed by polarity and clipped at +-3; group = equal-weight mean of available members (min 3); dial = 100*Phi(mean); headlines = equal-weight means of group means; Polish counterpart of macro_composite.py (pl_build.py)

fiscal.units: pp of GDP, + = loosening (minus the 4-quarter change of the general government balance)

curve_probit.units: percent probability of a downturn 12 months after d, indicative
curve_probit.source: Yield-curve probit with the New York Fed coefficients applied to the Polish curve (POLGB 10y fitted yield, monthly mean, minus WIBOR 3M monthly average); the coefficients are US estimates and Poland has no official recession dating, so the level is indicative and the direction is the information

sahm.units: percentage points, LFS unemployment rate (SA), 3-month mean minus its 12-month low; rule triggers at 0.50

piger.units: not available for Poland (no Chauvet-Piger counterpart)
